title: Standard 11.5 g composite "dice" poker chip — solid colour body, recessed colour centre with a thin inlay ring, 6 contrasting white edge spots bearing dice pips, ridged rim
era: Modern retail home-poker chip (ABS / clay-composite with a metal weight insert). The classic 5-colour 'dice' / 'striped dice' set: white, red, blue, green, black.
scope_note: Owner brief: classic dice chip ('nudná klasika'), and PREPARE THE CODE FOR SKINS (a chip-skin registry like the card backs — this dice design is skin v1). Built as a modelgen voxel prop; in-game the body colour is set per denomination and chips are stacked.

sources.casinosupply_dice: Casino Supply «11.5 Gram Dice Rim Poker Chips» — 39 mm diameter; 'Six tabs with dice imagery'; injection-moulded in two separate colours; clay composite with a metal insert for weight — https://www.casinosupply.com/products/11-5-gram-dice-rim-poker-chips-25-pkg-1
sources.cardplayerlifestyle_size: Card Player Lifestyle «Casino-grade poker chips guide» — casino chip diameter 'right at 39 mm', thickness 'at or around 3.5 mm', weight range 9–15 g with 11.5 g a common benchmark — https://cardplayerlifestyle.com/poker/casino-grade-poker-chips-ultimate-guide/
sources.amazon_dice_dims: Amazon «Striped Dice 11.5gm Poker Chips» listing — retail dice chip spec 1.58 in diameter × 0.13 in height (≈ 40.1 mm × 3.3 mm) — https://www.amazon.com/Striped-Dice-11-5gm-Poker-Chips/dp/B003CUW97C
sources.brpro_39mm: BR Pro Poker «Standard Casino Chip Size» — 39 mm (1.5 in) standard casino chip diameter — https://brpropoker.com/products/copy-of-custom-39mm-1-5-inch-chips-standard-casino-chip-size
sources.pokerchiplounge_dice: Poker Chip Lounge «Striped Dice 11.5 Gram ABS» — 'six embossed dice, striking striped patterns, and a refined dashed inlay border'; ABS composite resin with a metal insert — https://pokerchiplounge.com/products/striped-dice-11-5-gram-abs-poker-chips
sources.wiki_casino_token: Wikipedia «Casino token» — chips ~39 mm; authentic casino chips compression-moulded; 'there is no universally standardised colour scheme'; US casinos ~10 g (8–16 g worldwide) — https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Casino_token
sources.poker_org_values: poker.org «Poker chip values» — common colour→value: white $1, red $5, blue $10, green $25, black $100, purple $500, yellow $1000 — https://www.poker.org/poker-chip-values/

overall.note: Retail 11.5 g 'dice' chip ≈ 40 mm (1.58 in) Ø × 3.3 mm (0.13 in) — casino-standard is 39 mm; used 40 mm to match the retail dice chips in the reference. Weight is flavour only (metal insert), not modelled.
overall.src: amazon_dice_dims (40.1 mm × 3.3 mm) + cardplayerlifestyle_size (~39 mm / ~3.5 mm) + casinosupply_dice (39 mm) + brpro_39mm

center_inlay.ring: a thin dashed inlay ring bounds the smooth recessed colour centre
center_inlay.note: Smooth slightly-recessed colour centre (same colour as the body) inside a thin inlay ring. Centre Ø ~24–26 mm is DERIVED from the photo (no retailer publishes it); ring + slight recess photo-observed.
center_inlay.src: pokerchiplounge_dice (refined dashed inlay border); centre diameter DERIVED from ref-dice-chips.png

edge_spots.note: Six contrasting WHITE rectangular edge spots (tabs) evenly spaced around the rim (60° apart), each carrying small dice-pip faces (the 'dice' design); moulded-in, not stickers. Spot size ~7×10 mm is DERIVED from the photo. The pips themselves (~1–2 mm) are below the modelgen marking threshold → omitted (needs[]).
edge_spots.src: casinosupply_dice (six tabs with dice imagery) + pokerchiplounge_dice (six embossed dice); spot dimensions DERIVED from ref-dice-chips.png

construction.material: ABS / clay-composite resin, two-colour injection moulded, with a metal slug insert for weight; ridged/textured outer edge; edge spots are moulded-in contrasting plastic.

color_denom.map: white=$1, red=$5, blue=$10, green=$25, black=$100 (the 5-colour dice set); purple=$500, yellow/gold=$1000 for higher game denominations
color_denom.note: Common US/home convention — sourced — but NO universal standard (venue-dependent). The body colour is set per denomination IN-GAME; the modelgen model is built in one representative colour.

derivation.spot_ring_radius_m: 0.016 — spots centred ~4 mm in from the 0.020 rim so they span the rim edge
derivation.src: geometric derivation from specifications.overall + specifications.center_inlay + specifications.edge_spots

feature_inventory.feature: Solid colour disc body, Ø40 × 3.3 mm (colour = denomination, set in-game)
Smooth slightly-recessed colour centre inside a thin dashed inlay ring
Six white rectangular edge spots, 60° apart, spanning the rim (the 'dice' tabs)
Dice pips on each edge spot (~1–2 mm) — below modelgen marking threshold, omitted

images.shows: White/red/blue/green/black 11.5 g dice chips — solid body, smooth recessed colour centre with a thin ring, six white edge spots carrying dice pips around the rim.
